course.title: L68 Control, Design, and Development
course.description: 用记录、页面、故事、科学和系统说明控制、损坏、决定、设计、破坏、发展、发现、分配、影响和扩张。 场景：学员看一个项目记录页：设计、决定、发展、发现、分配、效果和扩张都写在页面上。 目标词：control, damage, decision, design, destruction, development, discovery, distribution, effect, expansion。核心句型：... has ... / I ... / The ... has ... / ... is in ... / ... is/are ... / ... is on ... / ... is in fiction / ... gives ...。
